theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_rotation_conservation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 / 4 → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection x = x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, 0 < inner ℝ x a → |‖x‖ - 1| < s → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s / 2 * ‖x‖ ∨ 2 * s * ‖x‖ < ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖) → ∀ ψ l : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → ContDiff ℝ 1 l → tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioo (-s) s → tsupport l ⊆ Ioo (1 - s) (1 + s) → IntegrableOn (fun x : Euclid P => deriv ψ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)) * l ‖x‖ * (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2)) {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} R.measure ∧ ∫ x in {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖}, deriv ψ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)) * l ‖x‖ * (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure = 0
